name: Driving Simulator Little Rock
summary:
The dream drive, from the driver's seat - through Little Rock.

YOUR GARAGE
Start in a luxury three-car garage with a supercar either side of you. Touch the throttle and the door lifts.

THE CAR
A V12 sports car with a race cockpit: racing wheel, bucket seats, shift lights and a live display. Grip the wheel, work the gear stick and pull the handbrake with your controllers - or put them down and drive with your bare hands.
